verdict.rationale: Brevo documents drag-and-drop email composition with templates ("just drag, drop, and send"), unlimited contact segments, scheduled future sending, and send-time optimization, so the core loop is evidenced. The links between steps are only implied: no doc explicitly shows choosing a segment as a campaign's audience, and the scheduling citation sits among developer API docs rather than marketing campaign docs. missing for 10: explicit evidence of selecting a list/segment as a campaign's recipients, campaign-specific (non-API) scheduling documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration of the end-to-end campaign send.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can compose an email campaign, pick its audience, and send or schedule it — the arena's table-stakes loop

citations.quote: Craft polished emails fast—just drag, drop, and send.
Jumpstart campaigns with responsive templates tailored to your industry and use case.
Create as many segments as you need.
Schedule emails to be sent at a specific time in the future.
Automatically send emails when each contact is most likely to engage.
